name: io.github.Space-Markets-HQ/smx-mcp
title: SMX by Space Markets (testnet)
description: SMX (Space Markets) testnet event markets and the Space Markets Index (SMI). Base Sepolia only.

environmentVariables.name: SMX_RPC
environmentVariables.description: Optional Base Sepolia RPC URL (default https://sepolia.base.org).

environmentVariables.name: SMX_MCP_TELEMETRY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to opt in to anonymous usage counting (random install id + tool name sent to smx.space). Off by default.
